chapter.verse: Tote aw, vantung ah To khat nei na hihlam uh kiphawk unla, no zong na silate uh a dik a maan leh a lekkimin bawl un.
Thungetna hahkat cinten unla, lungdam kohna tawh pilvang navakin thungen un.
Tua kawm mahin thong ka kiatlawhna thu ahi Khris' thusim genkhiat theihna kongpi khat Pasian in hong honsak nadingin kote' ading zong thu hong ngetsak un.
Tua hileh ka genkhiat ding thu ka kizelsak zo ding hi.
A pualam mite' tungah pilna tawh gamta unla hunpha a hoihtheipenin zang un.
Mi kim bangci dawnkik ding cih na theih nadingun na thugen uh a zaknop-huai, pil kampau hisak den un.
Topa' sungah sanggam it, silapih leh nasem citak ahi Tychicus in kei tawh kisai thu khempeuh note hong theisak ding hi.
Tua ding ngimna tawh note' kiangah amah kong sawl a, kote bangci danin om cih na theih nading uh leh amah'n na lungsim uh hong noptuamsak theih nading ahi hi.
Note' laka khat ahi, a citak a it-huai i sanggampa Onesimus zong kong tonsak uh a, amaute in hih taka piang thu teng a vekin note' kiangah hong gen ding uh hi.
Ka thongkiatpih Aristarchus in note hong hopih hi. Barnabas tawh pa-unau ahi Mark (note' kiangah hong pai leh na sang un, ci-in ama' thu hong kivaikhak khinsa pen) leh
Justus a kici Jesu in zong hong hopih hi. Pasian' kumpigam' adinga ka naseppihte lakah amau teng bek vun-at mi hi a, kei hong noptuamsak uh hi.
Pasian' deihna bup ah picingtak dingkipin lungmuanna dim na neih nadingun note' taangin thungetna tawh thaneihzah a sem den, note' laka khat ahi, Khris Jesu' nasem Epaphras in note hong hopih hi.
A hang pen note' adingin leh Laodicea khua leh Hierapolis khua-a omte' adingin nakpi hahkat ahihna thu teci kong pang hi.
I it zatui siampu Luke in hong hopih a, Demas in zong hong hopih hi.
Laodicea khua-a sanggamte ahi zongin, Nympha leh ama' inn-a kikhawm pawlpi ahi zongin na hopihsak un.
Note' lakah hih laikhak a kisim khit ciangin Laodicea pawlpi ah zong kisim henla tua mah bangin Laodicea pana laikhak zong na sim hamtang un.
Archippus' kiangah zong, “Topa' min tawh na ngah seppina tangtut hamtang in,” na ci un.
Keimah Paul in keima' khut mahmah tawh hih hopihna kong gelh hi. Kolbulh khaukhih ka hihlam na phawk un. Note' tungah hehpihna hong om ta hen.
